svg.title: Dragos Sorescu
svg.desc: Aspiring machine learning engineer in Toronto, Canada. Research Assistant at Durham College’s AI Hub. Sunlight on Mount Rundle above the Vermilion Lakes in Banff, Alberta. Languages: Python, TypeScript, C++, SQL. ML & Data: PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, OpenCV, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn. LLMs & Evaluation: Claude API, LangChain, LangGraph, Ragas. Web & Backend: FastAPI, Svelte, Vite, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Streamlit. AI tools: Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Qwen. Development & Testing: Git, Linux, Docker, pytest, Locust. AWS: EC2, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, ECR, Bedrock. Google Cloud: Cloud Run, Artifact Registry, Compute Engine.
